channel.title: Employee Benefit News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Employee Benefit News (benefitnews.com)

item.title: This adviser coaches ex-NFL players on health insurance
item.description: Gina Downs does the blocking and tackling for retired athletes and their families when it comes to accessing medical and behavioral healthcare.

item.title: How this leader built a flexible and personalized benefit strategy
item.description: TextNow's VP of people and culture shares how empowering employees with offerings has led to better retention and performance.

item.title: Lawsuit calls out AI hiring practices that many employers use
item.description: Eightfold AI, which many companies use as they screen job candidates, is being accused of gathering information about applicants without their consent.

item.title: What the Savannah Bananas can teach us about benefits
item.description: We don't need a mascot doing the worm during open enrollment, but we can learn from the idea that fun drives engagement.

item.title: Why HR is investing in AI but hesitating to trust it fully yet
item.description: A new survey by Avature finds companies eager to invest in AI, even as shortages in skills and trust slow adoption across HR functions.

item.title: Wellhub's CPO calculates the ROI of caring
item.description: Livia Martini works to create a culture and benefits that support and instill confidence in employees, leading to better business outcomes.

item.title: Travel insurance emerges as new voluntary benefit add-on
item.description: Exec from Crum & Foster explains how the organization has seen tremendous success by covering travel protection for their own employees.

item.title: 5 considerations when supporting employee mental health needs and comorbid conditions
item.description: A whole-person approach to care, including analyzing data and breaking down access barriers, can better support workers.

item.title: How this AI agent is making the onboarding process simple for small businesses
item.description: DianaHR's AI solution was created to get a new hire from a signed offer letter to full integration quickly and securely.

item.title: Carrot creates more plan flexibility with fertility benefit options
item.description: The addition of a cycle-based plan design allows employers to increase customization of offerings — a growing trend amidst rising healthcare costs.
